Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
As a huge Weber fan, with the mini for beach charcoal cooking, and a full size charcoal kettle, the gas is a good compliment for different styles of cooking. This is my third gas Weber over the years and the size is just perfect. Not too large and plenty of cooking area. Like the NO DOORs look and find the changing of tanks to be easy to reach.
For the first time in many years of WEBERFAN, I must admit I feel snake bit on this grill. Examples as follows:
* The process of turning on the tank and letting the grill breath so that the regulator is correct is something new for me. Not sure if I was just lucky on previous grills but this one does require turning on tank, definitely waiting for at least 60 seconds before igniting....if you don't, the grill will not meet high heat. 
* Not sure if I like the change/.tweak Weber has done to the "flame" interior. I understand Weber made a change, per customer input, and changed the interior. I had for the first time in over 20 years, a flame up while cooking that burnt black the interior and melted the left turn on knob. I will accept it being my fault if the interior cleaning was not up to par but I do with great regularity, clean and empty this gas grill.

On the positive, the people on the consumer hot line have been EXTREMELY helpful and good listeners. I am so very happy with there offer to provide some new parts to get my grill back in shape.
Love my WEBERS!
Results.Title: Big Weber Fan

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Had a new small deck added to my home and needed a smaller grill. The Spirit fit the bill perfectly and we use it frequently. I wish it had a ceramic sear zone option. For searing, it’s doesn’t get quite hot enough.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill
Results.ReviewText:
We have owned, and purchased for gifts, many Weber products. When we moved into our retirement house four years ago, we purchased another brand because it came with a cover. Now it is rusted out. I knew better but...

New 210 lights and cooks like a dream. If only Weber made a proper fitting cover. With one fixed table and one folding, no cover works neatly.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago. We have used it 6 times sandlike the indirect heat method for chicken. The ignighter for #2 burner works sporadically. The grills are hard to clean and food now sticks to them. (We are following your instructions). It is hard to roll because there it is awkward to hold onto the shelf and puts stress on the shelf.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The Grill I just purchased is a replacement for my first Weber Gas Grill that I purchased in March of 1998.  That grill was a Spirit 500 Series that I used until I bought my new model Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill.  Prior to 1998 I used a Weber Charcoal Grill for several years.  I replaced that Grill with a newer model in 2000 and I am still using it.  MY Wife and I are in our 80s and still grill on a yearly average of twice a week.
